summary: Feature request to enable querying workflow state at a specific historical event rather than replaying the entire workflow history, useful for debugging long-running or closed executions with complex internal state changes.
userImpact: Developers can debug workflow state at specific points in execution history instead of replaying entire workflows, reducing analysis time for complex long-running executions.
proposedFix: Allow specifying a history event number along with the Query, so the workflow is only replayed up to that event before returning the Query result.
keyQuote: The ability to query a Workflow at a particular history event. The Workflow will only be replayed up to event N before returning the Query result.
